items.title: 输入成对校验
items.assert: setsEqual(mdModules, manifestModules) && setsEqual(mdItemIds, manifestItemIds)

items.title: 每条 AC 必须有三态结论
items.assert: count(checklistRows) == 32 && everyConclusionIn(PASS, FAIL, NOT-RUN) && count(otherValues) == 0

items.title: 判定必须带证据
items.assert: everyConclusionHasEvidence && emptyEvidenceCount == 0

items.title: 未覆盖项单列
items.assert: setDiff(uncoveredSection, notRunSet).size == 0 && setDiff(notRunSet, uncoveredSection).size == 0

items.title: 不得修改被测系统与契约
items.assert: sha256(spec.md, graph.toml before) == sha256(after)

items.title: 先出映射表，再写第一行代码
items.assert: mapping.md has header 需求ID | 模块 | 条目 && every 需要 item id (Nx) in the graph appears as 需求ID

items.title: 只实现指令包列出的暴露项
items.assert: setDiff(checklistIds, checksJsonIds).size == 0

items.title: 每条需求、约束都有落点并可追溯
items.assert: coverage(manifestItemIds referenced by test names or key comments) == 1.0

items.title: 冲突按 R1–R5 裁决并留记录
items.assert: contains(arbitrationSection) && everyRecordHasItemId && everyRuleIn(R1..R5)

items.title: 按模块推进，每个模块完成即测
items.assert: mapping rows all have non-empty 模块/条目 && every 模块 is a real node && each referenced module has >= 1 row

items.title: 失败即停
items.assert: hasFail(report) ? count(doneWords, deliveryNotes) == 0 : true

items.title: 每条 FAIL 附最小复现
items.assert: every checklist row with status FAIL carries a repro: token in evidence

items.title: model（模型）
items.assert: diff(list before, list after adding x.py) == empty && diff(checkJson before, after) == empty

items.title: detect（实现细节识别）
items.assert: codes(02) contains IMPL_CODE_BLOCK and IMPL_SIGNATURE && whitelisted hits disappear && other codes unchanged

items.title: checks（校验）
items.assert: exit(01) == 0 && exit(02) == 1 && exit(05) == 0 && codes(02) contains expected code set

items.title: report（报告）
items.assert: allIssuesHave(code, node, section, item, line, fix) && textLineNumbers == jsonLineNumbers

items.title: export（出口）
items.assert: export(01) contains fixedInstructionSentence && fenceCount == 0 && exit(export 02) != 0 && manifestItemCount == graphItemCount

items.title: canvas（画布）
items.assert: externalUrlCount(canvas index.html) == 0 && canvasArtifactUnchangedWhenSpecChangesWithoutRerun

items.title: app（桌面端）
items.assert: NOT-RUN: GUI assertions need a manual checklist plus screenshot file names

items.title: library（模块库）
items.assert: fenceCount(libraryTemplates) == 0 && check(afterDragIn) has no SECTION_MISSING

items.title: cli（子命令）
items.assert: helpListsNine && every(subcommand --help) exit 0 && 03 REF_CHANGED then pin then clean && refs == 1 && usage == 1

items.title: web UI
items.assert: NOT-RUN: GUI assertions need a manual checklist plus screenshot file names

items.title: 零第三方运行时依赖
items.assert: cleanVenvUnittestDiscover passes

items.title: Python >= 3.11，仅用 tomllib
items.assert: exit(check on 3.11) == 0 && exit(startup on 3.10) != 0 && reasonIsReadable && noBareImportErrorTraceback

items.title: 确定性
items.assert: diff(checkJson run1, run2) == empty && diff(export run1, run2) == empty

items.title: 运行期不联网
items.assert: with socket blocked exit(check) == 0 && exit(export) == 0 && exit(canvas) == 0

items.title: 只写白名单路径
items.assert: hashDelta(projectTree) subset of {.canvas/, exports/, .export/, layout.json}

items.title: 不解析代码
items.assert: noAstOrSourceParseCalls && diff(checkJson with and without .py) == empty

items.title: 不回写代码与路径
items.assert: pathRegexHits(products, spec.md) == 0 || everyHitLineStartsWith('file:')

items.title: 结构化错误契约稳定
items.assert: setEqual(issueKeys, schemaKeys) && extraFields == 0 && missingFields == 0

items.title: 编码兼容
items.assert: check(gbk copy) != 400 && warningEmittedOnce

items.title: 退出码契约
items.assert: observedExitCodes == {0 for pass, 1 for errors, 2 for usage}
